items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: And it wasn't nine months after that she was with Paul Caden.

ctx.x: She been looking back at the band.

You know how to do it. She just couldn't sing. And it wasn't nine months after that she was with Paul Caden. Great. Great. And I said, big money. I told her, I said, now can you imagine something like this?
That's right. Did she learn to sing or just a bit? Oh, yeah. She can sing. Can she sing?
